verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a Gazebo simulation tutorial (ros2-docs-16, ros2-docs-68). Its topic-based pub/sub, launch system and static name remapping (ros2-docs-20, ros2-docs-6, ros2-docs-31) are the mechanisms that let the same nodes talk to either a simulator or real hardware. A long-time user says sim comes 'for free' if you follow ROS conventions (ros2-comm-13), but no first-party doc explicitly describes running unchanged code against sim and the real robot. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sim-to-real code parity (e.g. hardware abstraction or use_sim_time/sim-clock handling), a documented workflow for swapping a simulated robot for real drivers, hands-on corroboration of no-rewrite transfer.
